query:
UPDATE sales 
SET saleDate = CONCAT('2024-12-31 ', TIME(saleDate))
WHERE saleType = 'DELIVERY' 
  AND (
    (saleDate >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND saleDate < '2026-01-02 00:00:00')
    OR (saleDate >= '2026-01-03 00:00:00' AND saleDate < '2026-01-04 00:00:00')
  )
  AND status = 'ACTIVE'
